notes: «حدثني ابن عباس، عن عمر» ends at Umar, the Companion whose words («قلت لأبي بكر») are the saying; «عمر» occurs second inside «معمر», so occurrence 2
«فحدثت عروة بن الزبير فقال هما عويم بن ساعدة ومعن بن عدي» is Urwa's identification with no isnad of its own: left out, not a second saying with a chain
the Prophet's death is the setting, not a link
